title: Remote desktop feels unusually laggy
description: Since the morning update, remote desktop feels unusually laggy. A few people are affected, with a workaround available; 8 users are affected. A fix can wait a week.
root_cause: A backup job saturated the branch uplink.
resolution_notes: Inspection confirmed that a backup job saturated the branch uplink. The technician moved the backup to its scheduled window and applied the approved traffic policy and measured round-trip latency during a remote desktop session; added a configuration check to the maintenance checklist.
resolution_steps: 1. Reproduced report 36 in the demo environment. 2. Inspected the relevant logs and configuration. 3. Moved the backup to its scheduled window and applied the approved traffic policy. 4. Measured round-trip latency during a remote desktop session. 5. Asked the reporter to confirm recovery.
